messages:
leo.reps: Armada (payments) wants to migrate from CompetitorX. They asked for a drop-in proxy, billing conversion (they bill S/M/L buckets), SCIM + BYOK, and notes on response deltas affecting their scoring pipeline. Can presales/eng advise?
hana.se: I can lead the proxy. Goal: preserve request/response shape so client changes are minimal. Key risks: tokenization token-count drift, default sampling differences, stop-sequence semantics.
mike.eng: Quick adapter example: CompetitorX call:
POST /v1/respond {"prompt":"...", "max_out":64, "stop":"\\n\\n"}
Translate -> Redwood:
POST /v1/completions {"model":"redwood-gen", "input":"...", "max_output_tokens":64, "stop_sequences":["\\n\\n"]}
Note: add output-normalizer to mimic stop truncation. Expect token counts +/- ~5-12 tokens.
sara.security: Security asks: SCIM/SAML, BYOK (AWS/GCP KMS), audit log export, IP allowlist, EU residency + SOC2 addendum. I'll start SA doc and request their compliance contact.
ruth.solutions: I'll assemble a parity suite: 200 representative prompts across ranking, summarization, and NLU. Run A/B vs CompetitorX and Redwood (standard + quantized). Measure major-regression rate and per-band token distribution. Also build a small cost estimator: sample responses per bucket -> avg tokens -> monthly cost = avg_tokens * per_token_rate * monthly_volume.
leo.reps: Acceptance criteria proposal: (1) parity suite <=3% major regressions; (2) P95 latency <700ms at their expected load (~120 TPS); (3) billing projection within 12% after sampling; (4) security questionnaire signed.
hana.se: Timeline: day 0-1 creds + security kickoff; day 2-4 build proxy + smoke; day 5-7 run parity & billing samples; day 8 demo. I'll spin up a small staging proxy repo.
mike.eng: Engineering caveat: if their ranking uses exact character offsets for spans, tokenization diffs can misalign offsets. We can add a best-effort char->token mapping in the proxy but document edge cases.
sara.security: Please DM me their compliance email and sample ACLs. I'll attach the questionnaire once I have contacts.
leo.reps: Sent DM. Please post proxy repo link and parity harness here when ready. Keeping this thread for POC comms. :thumbsup:
